نستكلب (form X)
# نَسْتَكْلِبُ (nastaklibu) /nas.tak.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# نَسْتَكْلِبَ (nastakliba) /nas.tak.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# نَسْتَكْلِبْ (nastaklib) /nas.tak.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
